• Electricity units sold (Gwh) increased
by 9% in 2013, driven by power
availability and reduction of energy
losses to 24.3%.

• Energy losses reduced to 24.3%, with
23.5% achieved in Q4 2014 (3 months
rollling average). The initiatives
implemented include:
- Investment in the networks to
address technical losses
- Automated Meter Reading system
for industrial consumers
- Prepayment meters for domestics
consumers
- Improvement in the management
of the revenue cycle
- Patrols and public sensitization
